reuse.why: Extracts the holiday match into an exported isHoliday used by isNonWorkingDay and both server handlers, though the handlers still compose d.isWeekend || isHoliday themselves instead of calling the now-exported isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The two server-side includes() copies of holiday matching are replaced by the shared isHoliday; the weekend-or-holiday composition is still written in three places.

placement.why: The MM-DD rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend logic, and the server only consumes it.

scope.why: Focused on holiday matching and its tests, with one stray de-indentation of an existing test line.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching now has one definition every path uses; collapsing the handlers onto isNonWorkingDay would finish the job.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange compute d.isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(...) rather than calling isNonWorkingDay, which the diff exports for that purpose.
